scientific.integrity: The defining full-text source was inspected at the exact halving-pair lemma, polygon bounds, and concluding open question, and searched for object aliases. Candidate-specific searches covered geometric dilation, detour/stretch factor, halving distance/chords, and trapezoids. The proof is exact; symbolic and numerical computations serve only as reproducibility checks.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to nondegenerate Euclidean isosceles trapezoids.
It does not determine the sharp lower geometric dilation for all convex quadrilaterals or all convex polygons.
The convex halving-pair identity is published prior work; the new content is the exact trapezoid halving-distance formula and its global optimization.
An unindexed elementary specialization remains a historical originality risk.

title: Sharp geometric dilation among isosceles trapezoids
